draft.text: You came in because you have had abdominal pain for a week.
The pain is on both sides of your upper abdomen and has gotten worse over time.
You also feel nauseated and have been vomiting, but you do not have a fever.
The pain may be related to your increased coffee intake and eating spicy food.
You mentioned you have been drinking a lot of nitro cold brew and eating spicy food.
You will be advised to reduce your coffee and spicy food intake to see if your symptoms improve.
You should monitor your symptoms and return for follow-up if the pain does not get better or gets worse.
If your symptoms do not improve with dietary changes, the doctor may consider further tests or imaging in the future.
